Package io.goobi.viewer.managedbeans

Class CollectionBrowseBean

java.lang.Object
io.goobi.viewer.managedbeans.CollectionBrowseBean
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
@Named @SessionScoped public class CollectionBrowseBean extends Object implements Serializable
This bean provides the data for collection browsing (the collection hierarchy derived from a Solr field, plus database-defined dynamic collections). Term browsing is handled by TermBrowseBean.

    • getDynamicCollectionView

      public CollectionView getDynamicCollectionView(String name)
      Returns (and lazily builds and caches) the CollectionView for the database-defined dynamic collection with the given name. The view is backed by the collection's stored Solr query used as a filter query over the configured collection field.
      Parameters:
      name - unique name of the dynamic collection
      Returns:
      the collection view, or null if no such collection exists or it could not be built

    • removeDynamicCollectionView

      public void removeDynamicCollectionView(String name)
      Removes the cached collection view for the dynamic collection with the given name, forcing a rebuild on next access.
      Parameters:
      name - unique name of the dynamic collection
